description: Change a link's title, destination, code, note, start or end date, picture, featured card or bio-page visibility, or remove it (archived: true). Its short link stays the same. A section title (kind header) takes a title, dates and on_bio only. A download (kind file) takes a title, note, dates, on_bio, a new file (media_id), gate and email_list. Say a new end in words with ends ("end of November") and repeat ends_local back; still_works records that someone checked the code works.

after_end.description: Once it ends: hide (default) takes it off the page; show keeps it grayed out as ended for 14 days; shop keeps it as a plain shop link without the code

archived.description: Removes it from the page and stops its short link; undo brings it back

auto_apply.description: The short link applies the code at the store's checkout (store.com/discount/CODE), so visitors have nothing to type; the code stays shown as a backup. Shopify stores only: on any other site the link would not open. Needs a code

button.description: kind signup: the words on its button. Default "Send it"

email_list.description: kind file, with gate email: visitors may also agree to get your emails, and the page says so (audience_list opted_in). Default false

ends.description: Or when it ends in words, on the workspace's clock: "Nov 30", "11/30", "end of November", "Sunday", "2 weeks", "48 hours". A day ends at 11:59 pm

gate.description: kind file: email asks visitors for their email first; the file opens at once and a copy is mailed. They're added to audience_list. null (default) opens it with no question

gift_link_id.description: kind signup: a download (links_list kind file) on this page that is mailed to people after they sign up. null for none

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.

image_url.description: Or a picture at a public https address: it's copied into media and shows once ready

media_id.description: kind file: a new file in its place

percent_off.description: What the code takes off, in percent: the bio page says "20% off" beside the code. Set it whenever the code's percent is known

picture_from_page.description: Copy the picture its page shows (og:image) into media, once, when it has none. To swap a picture for its page's, pass image_media_id null too. Not for Amazon links

remind_days.description: A push this many days before it ends; null is off. Codes start at 2

still_works.description: Someone checked the code still works: clears reports and a broken-link flag, and answers check_due

url.description: Where it goes; https is added if missing

welcome.description: kind signup: send a welcome email after signup (with the gift's link when gift_link_id is set). Default false

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.

name: link_update
title: Edit or remove a link
